messages.text:
Added [DES-004 tracker input](docs/design/inputs/DES-004-tracker.md).

Covers forward vector-field effects, limited transverse measurement span, end-field diagnostics, propagation requirements, missing crossings and timing interfaces. Explicitly avoids interpreting benchmark endpoint fields as η=4 tracking performance.

Checks passed: whitespace, 30 session records, dashboard validation. No solver rerun, particle propagation, shared-file edits or commits.

limitations: Only userMessage and agentMessage text retained; reasoning, tool arguments/results and private state excluded.
Conservative path, credential, email and URL redaction is not a privacy guarantee; review retained text.
Exposed operation counts are per retained turn; journal counts can describe the same invocations and must not be added.
